en.headline: Five firms bid for first Loop park land, official says
en.dek: The HSITP chairman said the first two land groups drew six bids, including chip, AI and quantum companies, with results expected around November.
body: Five companies submitted six bids for the first batch of land at the Hong Kong–Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park in the Loop, the park’s chairman and Permanent Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Esmond Chiu, said in a television interview broadcast on Sunday.

The first invitation covered two groups of sites, each pairing an innovation-and-technology plot with an optional talent-apartment plot. Mr Chiu said three of the five bidders were companies whose core work is in frontier fields such as chips, artificial intelligence and quantum technology, and that the other two were conglomerates with research arms. He said assessment under the dual-envelope system would weigh technical quality, economic output and jobs more heavily than price, and that evaluators would also look at winning bid levels at Sha Ling and Hung Shui Kiu.

Hong Kong–Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park Limited has said it aims to finish assessing the first batch within the year. Mr Chiu said the company was considering whether to announce those two groups earlier than later batches. A second tender for four further sites closes at noon on 20 October.

Three of eight government-built buildings in the park’s first phase are already completed, with the rest topping out. Mr Chiu said arrangements for the so-called four flows of people, goods, capital and data had yet to take effect, but that he expected staged progress from late this year into the middle of next year.

zh.headline: 河套首批用地五企入標 包括晶片及人工智能
zh.dek: 港深創科園主席蔡傑銘表示，首兩組地共接獲六份標書，評標會着重技術含金量，預料約11月公布。
body: 港深創新及科技園有限公司主席、創新科技及工業局常任秘書長蔡傑銘在周日播出的電視訪問中表示，河套香港園區首批用地共有五間公司提交六份標書，當中包括從事晶片、人工智能及量子科技的企業。
首批招標為兩組地塊，每組包括一幅創科用地，投標者可同時競投一幅人才公寓用地。蔡傑銘稱，五間公司其中三間本身從事前沿科技，另外兩間為設有科研部門的綜合企業。園區採用雙信封制，技術建議佔七成、價格建議佔三成。他表示評標會着重技術含金量、經濟效益及就業，亦會參考沙嶺及洪水橋片區的中標價。
園區公司早前表示爭取年內完成首批評標。蔡傑銘稱正研究是否可較早公布該兩組結果。第二輪另外四幅用地招標於10月20日中午截止。
由政府興建的園區第一期八幢大樓已有三幢落成，其餘陸續平頂。蔡傑銘承認園區「四流」至今尚未落實，但預期由今年年底至明年年中會分階段有方案實施。
